quarterly_data.signal: Kulicke & Soffa's 10-K: bookings were $750,781 thousand in fiscal 2025 versus $430,994 thousand in fiscal 2024, and backlog (customer orders scheduled for shipment within the next twelve months) was $245,280 thousand as of October 4, 2025 versus $148,585 thousand as of September 28, 2024; a majority of orders are subject to cancellation or deferral with limited or no penalties. Inventory purchase obligations were $177,305 thousand, all due in fiscal 2026, and fiscal 2026 capital expenditures were expected to be between $8.0 million and $12.0 million.
